text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Would you... please become my Trainer...?!

—It came out of nowhere.
I never dreamt in a million years that she would ask for an exclusive contract.

Her name is Curren Bouquetd'or, the girl who always decorates the trainers' lounge with flowers.
A horsegirl with a kind, gentle disposition.

However, that kindness meant she wasn't cut out for competition—
that was the consensus among the trainers, and it worried me.

At one point, she seemed to hesitate over whether she should quit racing entirely,
so I had assumed she wouldn't be debuting anytime soon.
choice_data_list: Um, does this mean you're thinking about debuting?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I will make my debut.
Aiming for victory—I will run...!
choice_data_list: Are you pushing yourself too hard? ...Are your doubts gone?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I— C... I can't say I have absolute confidence.
However... —I no longer have any doubts.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—There is something I want to accomplish.
To do that, I have to win... So, I will run—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Would you come watch the division tournament?
To see whether or not I truly have the resolve to seize victory—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want you to bear witness to it...!

...We're a lot alike. I hesitate, worried that
I might not be capable of providing what she lacks.

And yet—her dark hazel eyes waver.
Her clenched fists are trembling ever so faintly.

Seeing her desperately muster all her courage to make this plea, I sensed her sheer sincerity.
—There was no mistaking that a change had occurred within her heart.
choice_data_list: Alright. I promise I'll be there to watch.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—! I'll give it my all...!

—The division tournament.
Curren Bouquetd'or was entered in the turf 1600m. And running in that race was—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
There she is! Almond Eye!
Out of all the horsegirls debuting this year, she's leagues ahead of the rest!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Eye-chaaan!
Show us that breathtaking late burst of speed!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—What an incredible roar from the crowd... Everyone came here to see Eye-san.
Going up against someone commanding this much attention... Urgh, but still—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um... Eye-san!
I look forward to racing against you today...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's have a good race. I won't lose to anyone!
Not even to you, Bouquet-chan!

—As the race unfolded, Almond Eye missed the start,
allowing Curren Bouquetd'or to secure a favorable position in the lead pack.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Kh—! But I can still turn this around!
The real race begins once we hit the final stretch!

If she maintained this momentum, Curren Bouquetd'or had a real shot at winning.
However, in the final stretch—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Here I come! HAAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ugh...!

Curren Bouquetd'or flinches, overwhelmed by the momentum.
Her face contorts in pain, just as it always had.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(...Such overwhelming fighting spirit—Eye-san's sheer aura is about to crush me.
Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (If I want to take that person's hand—I have to show my resolve!)

I'll cling on with everything I have. To Almond Eye—
whose obsession with victory surpasses anyone else's!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Leading toward a bouquet of glory—my very first victory!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAHHHHHHH!
—A piercing brilliance blazed within her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I couldn't... win... Of all the races... this one.
I wanted to win this one so badly... *sob*...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Bouquet-chan.
The way you ran today was completely different from before.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If you can change this much, you can become so much stronger!
So let's race again. In the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Trainer-san.
I'm so sorry... You came to watch me, and yet I lost.
choice_data_list: No. That was a great run.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I wanted to win and show you my resolve.
I'm so frustrated...
choice_data_list: You've come to truly desire victory now, haven't you?
You've come to truly desire victory now, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Trainer-san. ...While I was agonizing over whether
to keep racing, you stood by my heart time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Not just for me, but for every Umamusume—Trainer-san,
you pour every bit of your time and devotion into us without holding back.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
There is no other Trainer as wonderful as you.
I want to show the world how amazing you are. —Through my running.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Right now, I cannot offer you even a single bloom of victory.
But if I am with you... I know I can give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: And one day, I will gather enough triumphs to overflow from my hands.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —I want to deliver a brilliant golden bouquet to you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So please, I beg of you—
will you become my Trainer...?!

...Tears glisten in her trembling eyes. Yet,
even while wracked with anxiety, her gaze remains fixed straight upon me.
choice_data_list: (This is surely the very first spark of her courage.)

text_block_list.text:
If I miss this chance, her talent might fade away before it ever gets to shine.
And more than that...
choice_data_list: —I want to be the best for you, too.
—I want to be the best for you, too.

text_block_list.text: She resolved to change herself just to take on the world with me—and I want to honor that.
choice_data_list: I'll do everything I can to be the best Trainer for you!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —! ...Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I look forward to working with you—!

She gives a soft, gentle smile, blooming like a delicate flower.
—I vow right here to make that brilliant smile blossom in all its beauty.
